mapper.select: SELECT v.space_id,v.workspace_id,v.file_id,v.id AS version_id,a.id AS asset_id,f.name,a.object_key,v.size_bytes AS bytes,v.sha256 FROM pf.file_version v JOIN pf.file_entry f ON f.id=v.file_id AND f.space_id=v.space_id AND f.workspace_id=v.workspace_id JOIN pf.asset_object a ON a.id=v.asset_id AND a.space_id=v.space_id AND a.version_id=v.id AND a.status='AVAILABLE' AND a.size_bytes=v.size_bytes AND a.sha256=v.sha256 JOIN pf.workspace w ON w.id=v.workspace_id AND w.space_id=v.space_id AND w.state='READY' WHERE v.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND v.file_id=#{file} AND v.id=#{version} AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId})
SELECT request_hash,preview_id,kind FROM pf.preview_request WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{request}

SELECT FROM pf.preview_job WHERE space_id=#{space} AND version_id=#{version} AND bundle=#{bundle} AND policy_hash=#{policy} AND requested_format<>'HTML_STATIC'requested_format=#{format} ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM pf.preview_job WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT bytes,status FROM pf.preview_reservation WHERE preview_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.space_storage SET reserved_bytes=reserved_bytes+#{bytes},version=version+1 WHERE space_id=#{space} AND status='ACTIVE' AND object_limit_bytes-reserved_bytes-committed_bytes>=#{bytes}

UPDATE pf.space_storage s SET reserved_bytes=s.reserved_bytes-r.bytes,committed_bytes=s.committed_bytes+#{bytes},version=s.version+1 FROM pf.preview_reservation r WHERE r.preview_id=#{id} AND r.space_id=s.space_id AND r.status IN('RESERVED','RECONCILING') AND r.bytes>=#{bytes} AND s.reserved_bytes>=r.bytes

UPDATE pf.space_storage s SET reserved_bytes=s.reserved_bytes-r.bytes,version=s.version+1 FROM pf.preview_reservation r WHERE r.preview_id=#{id} AND r.space_id=s.space_id AND r.status IN('RESERVED','RECONCILING') AND s.reserved_bytes>=r.bytes
UPDATE pf.preview_reservation SET status=#{state},revision=revision+1 WHERE preview_id=#{id}
mapper.select: WITH picked AS(SELECT id FROM pf.preview_outbox WHERE status='PENDING' OR(status='PUBLISHING' AND relay_until<=clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 4) UPDATE pf.preview_outbox o SET status='PUBLISHING',relay_owner=#{owner},relay_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '10 seconds' FROM picked p WHERE o.id=p.id RETURNING o.id,o.preview_id,o.space_id,o.generation,o.relay_owner
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.preview_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED''PENDING',relay_owner=NULL,relay_until=NULL WHERE id=#{item.id} AND preview_id=#{item.previewId} AND generation=#{item.generation} AND relay_owner=#{item.relayOwner} AND status='PUBLISHING'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.preview_outbox WHERE id=#{item.id} AND preview_id=#{item.previewId} AND space_id=#{item.spaceId} AND generation=#{item.generation})
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.preview_outbox SET status='PENDING',relay_owner=NULL,relay_until=NULL WHERE id=#{item.id} AND preview_id=#{item.previewId} AND generation=#{item.generation}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.preview_inbox(event_id,preview_id) VALUES(#{item.id},#{item.previewId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT kind,reference_id,generation,owner_id,fence FROM pf.heavy_runtime_slot WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.heavy_runtime_slot SET kind='PREVIEW',reference_id=#{id},generation=#{generation},owner_id=#{owner},fence=#{fence},revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1 AND kind IS NULL AND fence=#{fence}-1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_sandbox_slot WHERE environment_id IS NOT NULL)

UPDATE pf.heavy_runtime_slot SET kind=NULL,reference_id=NULL,generation=NULL,owner_id=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1 AND kind='PREVIEW' AND reference_id=#{command.previewId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND fence=#{command.fence}

UPDATE pf.preview_job SET state='RUNNING',owner_id=#{owner},fence=#{fence},lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',deadline_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '120 seconds',attempts=attempts+1,revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND state='QUEUED'

UPDATE pf.preview_job j SET state='FAILED',error_code='PREVIEW_AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED',retryable=false,revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND state='QUEUED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.preview_attempt a WHERE a.preview_id=j.id AND a.generation=j.generation)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pf.preview_attempt WHERE command_id=#{command} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.preview_attempt SET runner_id=#{runner},status='STARTED' WHERE command_id=#{command.commandId} AND preview_id=#{command.previewId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND fence=#{command.fence} AND status='CLAIMED' AND runner_id IS NULL

UPDATE pf.preview_attempt a SET runner_id=#{runner},status='NEVER_ACCEPTED' WHERE command_id=#{command.commandId} AND preview_id=#{command.previewId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND fence=#{command.fence} AND status='CLAIMED' AND runner_id IS NULL AND container_id IS NULL AND NOT start_requested AND receipt_json IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.preview_job j WHERE j.id=a.preview_id AND j.command_id=a.command_id AND j.generation=a.generation AND j.owner_id=a.owner_id AND j.fence=a.fence AND j.state IN('RUNNING','BLOCKED') AND j.lease_until<=clock_timestamp() AND j.deadline_at<=clock_timestamp())
UPDATE pf.preview_attempt SET container_id=#{container} WHERE command_id=#{command.commandId} AND runner_id=#{runner} AND container_id IS NULL AND NOT start_requested AND receipt_json IS NULL
UPDATE pf.preview_attempt SET start_requested=true WHERE command_id=#{command.commandId} AND runner_id=#{runner} AND container_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT start_requested AND receipt_json IS NULL
UPDATE pf.preview_attempt SET started_at=#{started} WHERE command_id=#{command.commandId} AND runner_id=#{runner} AND start_requested AND started_at IS NULL AND receipt_json IS NULL

UPDATE pf.preview_attempt SET container_id=coalesce(container_id,#{container}),start_requested=(start_requested OR #{requested}),started_at=coalesce(started_at,#{started,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) WHERE command_id=#{command.commandId} AND runner_id=#{runner} AND status='STARTED' AND receipt_json IS NULL AND(container_id IS NULL OR container_id=#{container})

UPDATE pf.preview_attempt SET exec_id=#{exec} WHERE command_id=#{command.commandId} AND runner_id=#{runner} AND status='STARTED' AND container_id IS NOT NULL AND start_requested AND receipt_json IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.preview_read_exec(command_id,exec_id,ordinal) SELECT #{command.commandId},#{exec},coalesce(max(ordinal),0)+1 FROM pf.preview_read_exec WHERE command_id=#{command.commandId} ON CONFLICT(command_id,exec_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.preview_attempt SET receipt_json=CAST(#{json} AS jsonb),receipt_hash=#{hash},status='STOPPED' WHERE command_id=#{command.commandId} AND runner_id=#{runner} AND receipt_json IS NULL
UPDATE pf.preview_attempt SET source_closed_at=coalesce(source_closed_at,clock_timestamp()) WHERE command_id=#{command.commandId} AND runner_id=#{runner} AND status='STARTED'
mapper.insert: WITH prior AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT owner_id FROM pf.file_transfer_slot WHERE id=1 AND process_role='RUNNER' AND process_id=#{runner} AND object_key_hash=#{keyHash} FOR UPDATE),stopped AS(UPDATE pf.file_transfer_slot SET owner_id=NULL,object_key_hash=NULL,process_role=NULL,process_id=NULL,started_at=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1 AND owner_id IN(SELECT owner_id FROM prior) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.preview_attempt WHERE command_id=#{command.commandId} AND runner_id=#{runner} AND source_closed_at IS NOT NULL) RETURNING id) INSERT INTO pf.file_transfer_release(owner_id,proof_kind,preview_command_id) SELECT prior.owner_id,'PREVIEW_TRANSPORT_CLOSED',#{command.commandId} FROM prior,stopped
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.preview_job j JOIN pf.heavy_runtime_slot h ON h.id=1 AND h.kind='PREVIEW' AND h.reference_id=j.id AND h.generation=j.generation AND h.owner_id=j.owner_id AND h.fence=j.fence WHERE j.id=#{command.previewId} AND j.command_id=#{command.commandId} AND j.generation=#{command.generation} AND j.owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND j.fence=#{command.fence} AND j.state='RUNNING' AND j.lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND j.deadline_at>clock_timestamp())
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.preview_job SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds' WHERE id=#{command.previewId} AND command_id=#{command.commandId} AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND fence=#{command.fence} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND deadline_at>clock_timestamp()

UPDATE pf.preview_job SET state=#{state},format=#{receipt.format,jdbcType=VARCHAR},output_object_key=CASE WHEN #{state}='READY' THEN #{receipt.objectKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ELSE output_object_key END,bytes=#{receipt.bytes},sha256=#{receipt.sha256,jdbcType=VARCHAR},media_type=#{receipt.mediaType,jdbcType=VARCHAR},pages=#{receipt.pages,jdbcType=INTEGER},error_code=#{error,jdbcType=VARCHAR},retryable=(#{receipt.retryable} AND #{state}='FAILED' AND #{error,jdbcType=VARCHAR}<>'PREVIEW_AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED'),revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{command.previewId} AND command_id=#{command.commandId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND fence=#{command.fence} AND state IN('RUNNING','BLOCKED')

UPDATE pf.preview_job SET state='QUEUED',generation=generation+1,command_id=#{command},asset_id=#{asset},output_object_key=#{key},owner_id=NULL,fence=NULL,lease_until=NULL,deadline_at=NULL,format=NULL,bytes=NULL,sha256=NULL,media_type=NULL,pages=NULL,error_code=NULL,retryable=false,revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND state='FAILED' AND retryable

UPDATE pf.preview_job SET state='BLOCKED',error_code=#{error},retryable=false,revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{command.previewId} AND command_id=#{command.commandId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND fence=#{command.fence} AND state='RUNNING'
UPDATE pf.preview_job SET state='BLOCKED',error_code='PREVIEW_RESULT_UNKNOWN',retryable=false,revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE state='RUNNING' AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pf.preview_job WHERE state='BLOCKED' ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT 8
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.preview_event(id,space_id,preview_id,revision,event_type) VALUES(#{id},#{job.spaceId},#{job.id},#{job.revision},'preview.state_changed') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
